title: Hearing on the Office of Community Hiring's progress
summary: The Council's Workforce Development Committee will examine how the Office of Community Hiring has implemented the City's program requiring contractors to hire low-income and disadvantaged New Yorkers on City contracts. As of the Fiscal Year 2026 Q4 report, 179 contracts worth nearly $3 billion carried community hiring goals, but most reported little or no progress and the reports do not state how many people were actually hired. The Committee wants to know how many New Yorkers have been hired since the rules took effect in January 2025 and how OCH holds vendors accountable for missed goals.
